qa_pairs.question: Which legal authorities and legislative acts govern the joint administration of Value Added Tax exemptions and customs-related fiscal tools like regulatory duties?
qa_pairs.answer: The government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue (NBR), exercises powers under section 19(1) of the Customs Act, 1969, and either section 14(1) of the Value Added Tax Act, 1991, or section 126(1) of the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012, to administer exemptions for both Value Added Tax and customs-related duties.
